facts.function: connects piston to crankshaft in diesel engine
facts.end_use: 14.8L diesel engines for Class 8 heavy trucks (heading 8704)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8409 parts suitable for use solely or principally with engines of 8407/8408
Section XVI note 2(b): parts suitable solely or principally with one kind of machine go to 8409; not excluded by notes 1
GRI 6: 8409.99 other (compression-ignition), 8409.99.91 to be installed in vehicles of 8704, .10 connecting rods

rejected_alternatives.reason: other; heavy trucks are vehicles of 8704 so .91 is specific

classification.rationale: Forged connecting rods for diesel engines are parts of heading 8407/8408 engines under Section XVI note 2(b). Diesel goes under 8409.99; used in Class 8 trucks (8704) so the 'to be installed in vehicles' line applies. N347490 (connecting rod, spark-ignition) supports the heading and the connecting-rods statistical line.
